# ASTalyzer scan menu
id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu.scan"
version: 0.2.0
kind: menu
description: Recursive scan actions for ASTalyzer.

layout:
  type: list
  title: ASTalyzer — Recursive Scan

items:
  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu-item.scan-api-recursive-run"
    label: Run Recursive Scan
    group: analysis
    action:
      type: udi-capability
      capability_id: "prismata.astalyzer.capability.scan-api-recursive"
    visibility:
      selection:
        required: false
      compatibility:
        types:
          - folder
          - file
        modes:
          - single
    hints:
      short: Recursively scan folder or file for APIs, imports, and signatures.
      long: >
        Select a folder or file and recursively scan for external API usage,
        imports, function signatures, inputs, outputs, and inferred types.

  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu-item.scan-api-view-last-output"
    label: View Last Output
    group: output
    action: "view_last_output"

  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu-item.scan-api-save-last-output"
    label: Save Last Output to File
    group: output
    action: "save_last_output"

  - id: "back"
    label: Back
    group: navigation
    action: "back"
